Study notes

Renders here are real. The deployed BLOCKS_VIDEO_V4 renderer on Base draws each card inside a 500,000,000-gas static call and returns a native SVG poster of frame 0, its lossless AVI and the self-contained player its animation_url embeds. The input is what mint() would store.

The lab block is simulated, as in the V3 diversity audit: block 13,000,000 on Base with a fixed timestamp, gas limit, base fee and beneficiary. Only prevrandao changes, and it is the seed shown on each card. Scene choice is computed in your browser with an exact port of the contract's seed and scene logic. Forced scene and rare studies search for seeds of that scene; they do not represent mint probabilities.
